g.title: crate Halo-inspired components for calm, compact desktop interfaces.
crate::button Pop button appearance and compact icon actions.
crate::chips Removable chips with application-owned additions.
crate::choice The segmented look of a radio group and the check row style.
crate::choice::appearance Appearance shared by indexed and keyed choice builders.
crate::color The pop kit's own colors as values a style or a draw call accepts.
crate::date Calendar and date input components.
crate::date::calendar Render calendar dates, navigation and day selection.
crate::display Surface, data and feedback components from the Halo prototype.
crate::form Editable form controls, including platform file drops and pickers.
crate::icons Embedded Tabler outline icons from the reference prototype (MIT).
crate::messaging Conversation rows, bubbles and typing indicators with caller-owned state.
crate::notifications Notification history with application-owned read state.
crate::patterns Reusable dashboard, navigation, conversation and scheduling patterns.
crate::recipes Halo styling for standard UI components.
crate::recipes_collections Halo recipes for the standard list and data table.
crate::recipes_extra Pop recipes for compound standard controls and button decoration.
crate::recipes_field Theme appearance for standard field labels, hints and errors.
crate::recipes_input Halo recipes for the standard tag input and number input.
crate::recipes_palette Halo recipes for the standard command palette.
crate::recipes_small Pop recipes for the standard toggle, progress bar and disclosure.
crate::resize Optional vertical resizing around an ordinary public text field.
crate::slot The deferred view a builder's slot method keeps until mount.
crate::tabs The Pop content of a tab or segment: icon, label and count badge.
crate::theme Install the Pop palette and complete standard component recipes.
crate::timeline Timeline entries with plain or application-provided rich titles.
crate::tokens Public Halo tokens; no renderer or engine values appear in this API.
crate::upload File-transfer rows accept application-owned metadata and progress.
